# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository guidance in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

Before beginning implementation, read [index.md](../index.md) and the
task-relevant documents it links to.

For every issue, update durable documentation when the implementation changes
architecture, behaviour, setup, API/data contracts, rules, AI behaviour,
safety controls, or user flows. Update `index.md` when the documentation map,
current capability/status, or project structure changes.

Do not expose secrets to the browser. Keep server-side game state authoritative.
